Name: Mahalath, Daughter of Jerimoth
Summary: Mahalath, daughter of Jerimoth son of David, was a wife of Rehoboam and bore him Jeush, Shamariah and Zaham.
KeyStory: Mahalath bore Rehoboam three children: Jeush, Shamariah and Zaham.
RelatedPeople: Rehoboam; Jerimoth, Son of David; Jeush, Son of Rehoboam
LifeLesson: Royal marriages wove David's house together, for better and for worse.
